text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis: \"the negative aspects outweigh the positive ones\"","quality":"argumentative stance","description":"It states a direct position early and keeps the essay organized around defending that claim."},{"evidence":"two developed body paragraphs on safety and boredom/technology","quality":"support development","description":"It expands its claim with multiple reasons rather than relying on a single unsupported objection."},{"evidence":"\"This additional feature... adds unneeded complications\" and \"It seems to be more of a hassle than a luxury\"","quality":"analysis","description":"It explains why the article’s details matter instead of only mentioning them."},{"evidence":"\"Although driverless cars could potentially... right now they are not a good investment\"","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges potential benefits and then directly refutes them to strengthen its position."},{"evidence":"introductory setup and concluding restatement","quality":"essay structure","description":"It has a clearer introduction, body development, and conclusion than the other essay."},{"evidence":"few spelling errors compared with the other essay","quality":"conventions","description":"It is generally more polished in spelling and sentence-level correctness."}]}
